# UI fixtures

Made by `scripts/lib/tool-ui.mjs` (`ensureFixtures`). Delete a file to have it rebuilt.

- `sample.docx`: one page, two paragraphs.
- `sample.pptx`: one blank-layout slide.
- `fillable.pdf`: a text field and a checkbox.
- `locked.pdf`: `qa-sample.pdf` encrypted with AES-128, password `pdfchef-qa`.
